purpose: Prove the constitution's terminal product proposition through an environment-attributed finite repeated-natural-task cohort: sustained goal-level delivery, lower user orchestration burden than same-starting-environment source-bound ad-hoc baselines, real demand-driven capability and carrier lifecycles, and live cross-host open reference delivery. v0.2 remains an immutable bounded calibration milestone and v1.0 remains an immutable stopped zero-outcome attempt; neither can satisfy this program by inheritance.

increments.observedProblem: The v1.1 acceptance authority now treats the starting environment as evidence rather than a permanent capability ceiling and requires dynamic current-source resolution, attributed lifecycle changes and minimal guided human-only action, but the current program has no distinct content-addressed v1.1 method and cohort-protocol candidate that realizes those semantics without reusing the contradictory stopped v1.0 operands.
increments.hypothesis: A separate pre-freeze v1.1 profile and cohort-protocol candidate, code-pinned only for review integrity and documented as subordinate zero-outcome input, can make the adaptive initial-environment contract reviewable without activating a cohort, changing consumer configuration, inheriting v1.0 state or adding acceptance authority.
increments.falsifier: Stop and remove the candidate if it copies or adds acceptance thresholds, becomes a fifth product authority, treats the initial environment as a static ceiling, permanently locks one external version, hides task-time configuration or capability deltas, transfers supported Agent work to the user, activates or installs a route, inherits v1.0 cohort state, promotes any O1-O5 result, or cannot be held byte-identical by code-owned review checks and tests.
increments.stopCondition: Stop after one distinct v1.1 profile candidate and one paired cohort-protocol candidate are code-pinned for review without becoming a verifier authority prerequisite, public supporting documents consistently identify them as pre-freeze and non-authoritative, drift and deletion fail candidate-integrity tests, canonical and product tests pass with O1-O5 still 0/5 and the normative binding still unfrozen, no consumer or private resource is touched, and this outcome-neutral increment is removed from the current graph.

deliverables: one distinct pre-freeze v1.1 method and minimum-quality profile candidate
one paired pre-freeze v1.1 prospective cohort protocol candidate
one code-owned candidate integrity seam with public status alignment
